name: Serena James
source:
The most fearsome pirate captain in all the realms, Serena carries herself with beautiful ferocity and poise. She wears her sword on her hip, but her heart is guarded by teasing grins and flirty quips. Her love is as fierce as her glare and runs deeper than the sea.

[From [url=https://fictif.fandom.com/wiki/Serena_James]FictIf Wiki[/url]]
